Referrer-Policy.purpose: Limit referrer information sent to other origins

Permissions-Policy.purpose: Disable browser features not currently required
Permissions-Policy.review: Update only if a feature requires a permission

Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy.review: Test OAuth, payment and popup workflows

intentionallyOmitted.Strict-Transport-Security: Enable only after confirming HTTPS coverage for all affected hosts
intentionallyOmitted.Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: Set according to actual cross-origin asset requirements
